question: Where can I find a golf course within 150 kilometers, oriented toward the northwest of Appalachian Wireless Arena, Pikeville, KY?
sql: WITH arena_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Appalachian Wireless Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Pikeville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT poi_name AS name FROM pois, arena_location WHERE pois.leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, arena_location.geometry::geography, 150000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(arena_location.geometry), ST_Centroid(pois.geometry))) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5 UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name FROM parks, arena_location WHERE parks.leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(parks.geometry::geography, arena_location.geometry::geography, 150000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(arena_location.geometry), ST_Centroid(parks.geometry))) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
